fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Deploy NAS protocol validation rules to block unregistered protocol discriminator values.
Set NAS sequence number thresholds to flag out-of-order or rapid sequence resets.
Enable NAS message integrity checks for EEA0/EEA1/128-EEA1 ciphering mismatches.
Implement RRC connection re-establishment counters for repeated failed handovers.
Configure core network to reject NAS messages with invalid EMM state transitions.
Enforce NAS message rate limiting per subscriber to detect spoofing attempts.
Deploy 5G authentication failure KPIs to trigger automated network isolation.
Update RAN to enforce strict gNB identity verification via IMEI/SN checks.
Enable NAS message replay detection with timestamp validation windows.
Configure core to drop NAS messages with nested field inconsistencies or missing flags.
